item.title: Markets Lab 25 Nov 2026
item.description: Markets Lab for Wednesday 25 November. This episode is read by a computer voice. ASX 200 -0.4%; best ETF on the list VAF.AX +0.2%, weakest NDQ.AX -2.8%. Most-shorted on the ASX: GMD at 20.4%. AU 10y at 5.08%, curve slope +27 bp. Bank bills vs RBA cash rate: 3m +8 bp, 6m +35 bp. AUD FX dashboard: biggest move AUD/HKD -0.2%. Volatility monitor: biggest move US VIX +12.3%. ASX 200 moved -0.4% on the day. Best ETF on the list: VAF.AX (Vanguard Australian Fixed Interest) +0.2%. Weakest: NDQ.AX (Betashares Nasdaq 100) -2.8%. Over one month the best was VAF.AX at +2.3%. Data as at 2026-11-19 (ASIC publishes with a lag). GMD 20.4% of shares on issue reported short. PLS 18.0% of shares on issue reported short.
